decisions.decision: load_qc_cohort rebalances on the post_split checkpoint READ-BACK (read_matrix_table _n_partitions), NOT a pre-write mt.repartition(shuffle=True)
decisions.rationale: pre-write repartition(shuffle=True) -> driver-side SpillingCollectIterator gather (the Gate B stall). Read-back uses the on-disk partition index (no key sampling). PROVEN live at re-fire #1.

decisions.decision: Interval suffix in intermediate checkpoint paths MUST be sanitized (':'->'_', '-'->'_') via _sanitize_interval_suffix
decisions.rationale: a raw colon (nano INTERVAL) survives GCS write but breaks Hadoop's Path parser on read-back (URISyntaxException). One shared helper; _intermediate_checkpoint_uri is the lone affected builder; _qc_checkpoint_uri carries no interval suffix (intended producer/consumer contract — notebook suffixes finals manually).

decisions.rationale: a nano-interval keeps the catastrophe-triggering profile faithful while making per-partition data trivial.
